answer_1.quote: FLEURS-ASL can be used to evaluate a variety of tasks-primarily sentence-and discourse-level translation, but also ... caption alignment, retrieval, and multiple-choice receptive comprehension-between ASL and all the languages supported by FLORES/FLEURS.
models: Unified sign language to text model (T5 baseline)
answer_1.outputs: sentence-level translation, discourse-level translation, timed translation, caption alignment

answer_2.quote: We recommend scoring sentence-level translation with both BLEU (with sacreBLEU with intl tokenization) and BLEURT (with BLEURT-20).

answer_4.quote: We recruited a native Deaf ASL signer with professional training/experience ... The annotator was informed of the purpose of their translations ... and paid at market rates. We sampled 8 articles uniformly at random ... the annotator was tasked with translating that sampled sentence's ASL clip back to English, and then ... translate it to English in its entirety.
answer_4.guideline: Translate the ASL clip back to English (sentence-level) and then translate the entire discourse (discourse-level).
